title: GTA 6 PS5 Controller Preorders Cause Chaos and Scalpers Hit eBay
description: Pre-orders for the new GTA 6 PS5 controllers went live, causing extreme chaos on PlayStation's store as scalpers quickly moved to resell them on eBay.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 PS5 Controller Pre-orders Spark Store Chaos

The anticipation surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6 continues to shatter expectations, extending well beyond the game itself and into official merchandise. This morning marked the official launch of pre-orders for the brand-new GTA 6-themed PS5 controllers, but what was supposed to be an exciting moment for fans quickly descended into an exceptionally chaotic experience.

According to reports from gaming media outlets like IGN Games, the digital queue and store traffic proved to be overwhelming. PlayStation's store experienced severe strain as massive numbers of eager fans and collectors flooded the platform all at once. For many attempting to secure the limited-edition hardware, the pre-order process was plagued by sluggish response times, connection errors, and extreme frustration.

## Scalpers Waste No Time on eBay

As is frequently the case with high-profile gaming hardware and collector's items, scalpers were quick to capitalize on the immense demand and technical hurdles. Almost immediately after the pre-orders went live and the store descended into chaos, listings for the GTA 6 PS5 controllers began appearing on eBay at inflated resale prices.

This rapid turnaround by resellers has once again ignited discussions within the gaming community regarding online queue management, bot protection, and fair access for genuine fans. Many dedicated players who simply wanted to purchase the controller for their collection found themselves empty-handed while automated bots and opportunists secured inventory to flip for a profit.

## Editor's Take

The chaotic rollout of the GTA 6 PS5 controller pre-orders highlights the sheer, unmatched magnitude of the game's cultural footprint. While the overwhelming demand was entirely predictable, the ensuing store meltdown and immediate eBay scalping demonstrate that major storefronts still struggle to protect genuine consumers from high-pressure launch environments. Until better anti-scalp measures are widely implemented, securing limited-edition gaming gear will remain an uphill battle for everyday players.
